title: Ya ali ummed e mehsharam
body:
Haider.. haider
<<DIVIDER>>
Taa surat e paywand jaha'n bood ali bood
taa nakshe zamee'n bood zamaa'n bood ali bood
ham adam o ham sheest o ham ayyub o hum idrees
hum yusuf o hum yunus o hum hood ali bood
wallah ali bood, ali bood,ali bood
taaro ne abhi aankh na kholi thi, ali tha
khaliq ki zubaa'n kun bhi na boli thi, ali tha
wallah ali tha, wallah ali tha.. ali
asadullah.. ali
wajhullah.. ali
karamullah.. ali
<<MINI>>
ya ali ummed e mehsharam..(2)
ya ali yeki e dilbaram..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
ek tu hi hijab e kibriya, ali ye imam e awwalam
1. Awwal adam e bus teri zaat e girami hai ya ali
hai tu hi zalik-al-kitaab e rabbe jali
tu ali, tu hi wali, tu hi jali, tu hi khafi
ali ya ali, humsari kare kya koi, bandagi kare kya koi
<<MINI>>
ya ali ya haider
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ya ali, chahiye teri aagahi, har jagah mile bus tuhi
<<MINI>>
ya ali ya haider
ya haider..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Shahid e mashoode do jahaa'n
raaz e kun ka tu hi raazdaa'n
qabl as kaun o makaa'n tu hi
khaliq e zameen o aasmaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
raaz e kibriya, juz tere koi nahi jaana ya ali
mere idraak ne ye maana ya ali
tu shafa, tu hi ataa, tu hi dawa, tu hi duaa
ali ya ali, tu mila meri zindagi, hogayi meri bandagi
<<MINI>>
ya ali ya haider
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ya ali, dar tera dar e kibriya, hashr ka tu hi aasra
<<MINI>>
ya ali ya haider
ya haider..(4)
ya ali ummed e mehsharam..(2)
ya ali yeki e dilbaram..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ishq e fatemeh rajaz e rooye labe shahe alameh
mikhunam mann bi tarso ba hameh
faqat e yare ke khalifeh be aalameh
ali ya ali, aabru e ghazanfari, ke shuja e ghazanfari
<<MINI>>
ya ali ya haider
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ya ali, quwat e farma rawa, nazr e tuye jaane maa
<<MINI>>
ya haider..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hai yehi hadees e mustafa
paak seeno mein teri wilaa
bus tera ishq jise milaa
tohfa e khuda hai ba khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
tu hai lafata, quwat e dast e khuda, tu hai ya ali, fatahe dasht e wigha
tu hai ya ali, ye karam jaho hasham, tegho alam, kisko mile
ali ya ali, khwahish e dile fatimi, nazishe kul hashimi
<<MINI>>
ya ali ya haider
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ya ali, ghalib e kulle ghalibe, bazu e abu talibe
<<MINI>>
ya ali ya haider
ya haider..(4)
Haider.. haider..
<<DIVIDER>>
Tegh e ali...
jab bhi chali...
qahr e khuda..
banke giri...
<<DIVIDER>>
Tegh e ali...
jab bhi chali...
qahr e khuda..
banke giri...
<<DIVIDER>>
rann me larazte the shaqi
maut bhi katrake chali
Dekhlo payenge ajal
khaima o siffeen o jamal
<<DIVIDER>>
dete the har jang mein jibreel sadaa
Ya qaheral aduwwe ya waliyal walii
ali.. ali.. ali.. ali...(2)
ali waliyullah.. haider
<<MINI>>
ali ayah.. haider
<<DIVIDER>>
ali nafsullah.. haider
ali yadullah.. haider
<<MINI>>
haider.. haider..
<<DIVIDER>>
haye tanhayi teri...(2)
Haq tera cheena gaya
tune shikwa na kiya
zakhmi pehlu pe tera
<<DIVIDER>>
maine girya bhi suna
ek bachhi sare zindaan bulati thi tujhe
yaad phir aagayi shabbir ki tanhayi mujhe
ek tanhayi sare dashte hirasa zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
bayn karti thi sare shaam e ghareeba'n zainab
haye tanhayi teri..(4)
Raza abbas kabhi mazhar abidi ki fugha'n
teri tanhayi tere saath gayi sue jinaa
<<DIVIDER>>
masjid e kufa se jibreel ki jab aayi sadaa
haaye..
qad qutilal ameeral mo'mineen... wawaila..
